claims.evidence: Factory H18 handoff protocol explicitly references 'multiple context compressions.' Multiple phases carry 'Compressed summaries are untrusted' rule.
claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: HIGH: if compact doesn't exist, the entire compact-after-first rule is irrelevant.

claims.evidence: No explicit compact-detection API observed in tool definitions. Handoff protocol assumes detection is manual/user-reported. No 'compactDetected' flag in app context.
claims.claim: Codex can detect that compact occurred
claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: HIGH: if compact cannot be detected, 'after-one-compact' rules cannot be automated.

claims.evidence: No tool or mechanism observed that creates a new UI window automatically. create_thread creates a thread (data), not a window (UI).
claims.claim: Codex can automatically create/fork a new user-visible window after compact
claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: MEDIUM: if we claim auto-window and it fails, session rotation breaks.

claims.evidence: fork_thread would fork current (post-compact) state. Compressed summaries are lossy by definition. Full pre-compact context is not recoverable from compressed state.
claims.claim: Forked thread inherits full pre-compact context
claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: HIGH: claiming full inheritance would create false trust in compressed context.

claims.evidence: Logical: fork_thread forks current state. If compact has already occurred, forked context is post-compact.
claims.claim: Forked thread inherits only current/compacted context
claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: Low — this is the conservative default.

claims.evidence: Factory evidence chain: artifact handoff is the only mechanism that preserves verifier results, SHA256, state. Compressed context cannot replace this.
claims.claim: New thread can safely continue large project without artifact handoff
claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: HIGH: skipping artifact handoff corrupts evidence chain.

claims.evidence: Factory H18-H24: every session rotation requires startup verification. 10+ rotations validated. This is Factory's proven mechanism.
claims.claim: New thread requires artifact handoff + startup verification
claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: LOW — this is the proven safe path.

claims.evidence: System prompt: 'Only use create_thread when the user explicitly asks.' Sub-agents are internal, not user-visible. spawn_agent doc says 'sub-agents inherit your current model.'

claims.riskIfAssumedWrong: LOW — sub-agents don't need user visibility.

claims.evidence: DRY20/DRY24 cross-worker deps validated. Worker contracts + fork_context:false provide isolation. This is Factory's standard pattern.
claims.claim: Subagent isolation is sufficiently handled by spawn_agent + fork_context:false + contracts

claims.evidence: System prompt: 'fork_context: true forks context into new agent.' Explorers need context. Used in H21 capability revalidation pattern.
claims.claim: fork_context:true is useful for handoff/explorer scenarios

claims.evidence: System prompt: 'false or omitted starts with only the initial prompt.' Factory worker contracts assume clean start.
claims.claim: fork_context:false remains default for isolated builders

claims.evidence: H21-A AUTO-07: CODEX_SELF_REPORT_ONLY. App context mentions 'thread wakeups.' Not tested.

policyTiers.rule: After confirmed compact, current window MAY finish the current narrow task. Do NOT start new major phase.
policyTiers.evidenceBasis: Factory handoff protocol: old window 'has had multiple context compressions'

policyTiers.rule: Before starting a new H/DRY/FINAL phase after confirmed compact, MUST perform session rotation: generate handoff, open new window, run startup verification.
policyTiers.evidenceBasis: H18-H24: all major phase transitions used artifact handoff

policyTiers.rule: After multiple compactions in same window, mandatory session rotation. No new major phase in current window under any circumstance.
policyTiers.hardRequirement: Rotate now. Current window is compromised for evidence purposes.

policyTiers.rule: When fork/create-thread capability is unknown in current environment, use manual new window + artifact handoff. This is always safe.
policyTiers.evidenceBasis: Factory's proven mechanism works regardless of fork/create availability

policyTiers.rule: If fork/create-thread is verified available AND user confirms, fork may be used as carrier. Artifact startup verification is STILL REQUIRED. Fork alone does not replace artifact handoff.
policyTiers.evidenceBasis: Conservative: fork may carry compressed context; artifacts are ground truth

finalPackageWording.recommendedPhrasing: Factory recommends artifact-based session rotation as the primary mechanism for context continuity across windows/sessions. If your Codex environment supports thread fork or new thread creation, these may be used as carriers, but startup artifact verification remains mandatory. Compressed summaries produced by context compaction are not trusted evidence — always validate against repo artifacts, verifier JSON, and manifest SHA256.
